-- Read-only: Gordon's attestation (confirmation link) state in tenant south-melb-lsc.
\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
\pset format aligned
\timing off

select now() as db_now_utc, now() at time zone 'Australia/Melbourne' as db_now_melb;

-- Tenant + settings that govern link lifetime
select id as tenant_id, slug,
       settings->>'attestationTokenExpiryDays' as token_expiry_days,
       settings->>'attestationAutoResend'      as auto_resend
from tenants where slug = 'south-melb-lsc';

select set_config('app.current_tenant_id',
       (select id::text from tenants where slug = 'south-melb-lsc'), false);

-- Candidate members named Gordon (first or last name) in this tenant
\echo '== candidates'
select u.id as user_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email,
       m.status as membership_status, m.current_season
from users u
join tenant_memberships m on m.user_id = u.id
 and m.tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')::uuid
where u.first_name ilike '%gordon%' or u.last_name ilike '%gordon%'
order by u.last_name, u.first_name;

-- Every attestation for those members, newest first
\echo '== attestations'
select u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as member,
       a.id as attestation_id, a.season, a.status,
       a.created_at at time zone 'Australia/Melbourne'        as created_melb,
       a.token_expires_at at time zone 'Australia/Melbourne'  as token_expires_melb,
       (a.token_expires_at < now())                           as token_lapsed,
       a.completed_at at time zone 'Australia/Melbourne'      as completed_melb,
       left(a.token, 8) || '…'                                as token_prefix
from attestation_requests a
join users u on u.id = a.user_id
where u.first_name ilike '%gordon%' or u.last_name ilike '%gordon%'
order by member, a.created_at desc;

-- Attestable credentials (active/expired) per candidate
\echo '== credentials'
select u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as member,
       c.serial_number, c.status,
       c.expires_at at time zone 'Australia/Melbourne' as expires_melb,
       c.programming_required
from credentials c
join users u on u.id = c.owner_id
where (u.first_name ilike '%gordon%' or u.last_name ilike '%gordon%')
  and c.tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')::uuid
order by member, c.serial_number;

-- Attestation emails: queued (cron auto-resend) rows
\echo '== email_queue attestationRequested'
select q.recipient, q.status, q.attempts, q.last_error,
       q.created_at at time zone 'Australia/Melbourne' as queued_melb,
       q.sent_at at time zone 'Australia/Melbourne'    as sent_melb,
       regexp_replace(q.payload->>'attestUrl', '.*/attest/(.{8}).*', '\1') || '…' as token_prefix
from email_queue q
where q.template_type = 'attestationRequested'
  and q.recipient in (
    select u.email from users u
    join tenant_memberships m on m.user_id = u.id
     and m.tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')::uuid
    where u.first_name ilike '%gordon%' or u.last_name ilike '%gordon%')
order by q.created_at desc;

-- Audit trail: renew / resend / auto-resend / email send events for those members
\echo '== audit'
select u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as member,
       l.created_at at time zone 'Australia/Melbourne' as at_melb,
       l.actor_type, l.action, l.entity_type,
       l.metadata->>'action' as meta_action,
       l.metadata->>'templateType' as template,
       l.metadata->>'cycle' as cycle,
       l.metadata->>'attestationId' as attestation_id
from audit_log l
join users u on u.id = l.entity_id
where l.entity_type = 'member'
  and (u.first_name ilike '%gordon%' or u.last_name ilike '%gordon%')
  and (l.metadata->>'action' ilike '%attest%' or l.metadata->>'templateType' = 'attestationRequested'
       or l.metadata->>'action' ilike '%renew%' or l.metadata->>'action' ilike '%email%')
order by member, l.created_at desc
limit 60;

#!/bin/bash
# Read-only prod pull for Gordon's attestation link check. Opens the Cloud SQL
# public-IP window, runs ~/pai-tmp/gordon.sql through cloud-sql-proxy, closes
# the window, and verifies ipv4Enabled is False. Never prints DATABASE_URL.
set -u
G=/opt/homebrew/bin/gcloud
P=/opt/homebrew/opt/libpq/bin/psql
PROXY=/opt/homebrew/bin/cloud-sql-proxy
PROJECT=accessbuddy-prod
INST=accessbuddy-production
REGION=australia-southeast1
SQL="$HOME/pai-tmp/gordon.sql"
PROXY_PID=""

cleanup() {
  [ -n "$PROXY_PID" ] && kill "$PROXY_PID" 2>/dev/null
  $G sql instances patch $INST --project $PROJECT --no-assign-ip --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1
  echo "IPV4_ENABLED_AFTER=$($G sql instances describe $INST --project $PROJECT --format='value(settings.ipConfiguration.ipv4Enabled)')"
  echo "CLOSED_AT=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

DBURL=$($G run services describe accessbuddy-production --region $REGION --project $PROJECT --format=json 2>/dev/null \
  | python3 -c "import sys,json; env=json.load(sys.stdin)['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['env']; print([e['value'] for e in env if e['name']=='DATABASE_URL'][0])")
if [ -z "$DBURL" ]; then echo "NO_DBURL"; exit 1; fi
LOCALURL=$(printf '%s' "$DBURL" | sed -E 's#@[^/@]+/#@127.0.0.1:5433/#')

echo "== opening IP window $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
$G sql instances patch $INST --project $PROJECT --assign-ip --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "PATCH_FAILED"; exit 1; }
$PROXY --port 5433 "$PROJECT:$REGION:$INST" >"$HOME/pai-tmp/proxy.log" 2>&1 &
PROXY_PID=$!
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if $P "$LOCALURL" -Atc "select 1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "DB_CONNECTED after ${i}s"; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
$P "$LOCALURL" -f "$SQL" 2>&1
echo "QUERY_DONE"

A South Melbourne LSC member named Gordon reports that his AccessBuddy confirmation link says it has expired.
